name: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
one_liner: Turns a single AI coding assistant into an entire pretend game studio — dozens of specialized AI 'employees' (designers, programmers, artists) that coordinate to help one person build a video game.
buyer: A solo indie game developer or very small team who wants the structure and coverage of a real studio (art, design, QA, production) without hiring anyone.
business_use_cases: A solo hobbyist uses it to go from idea to playable prototype faster by having 'specialist' agents handle art direction, level design, and QA in parallel.
A game-dev content creator builds tutorials and courses showing how to run an AI 'studio' to make games, monetized through sponsorships and course sales.
A tiny two-person indie studio uses it to cover roles (sound design, narrative writing) they don't have a human for.

money_ideas.idea: A paid course or coaching program teaching indie developers how to run this workflow to actually finish and ship a game.
Premium specialized agent/skill packs for specific genres (RPG systems, roguelike generation) sold to the existing user base.

steal_this: Use it this weekend to take one small, scoped game idea from concept to a playable prototype, then document and sell the process as a case-study course.
